newsitem.title: CHINA: China navy looks to cyberspace wars to cut costs.
newsitem.headline: China navy looks to cyberspace wars to cut costs.

text.p: China's navy has taken to cyberspace to fight mock battles that it says are much cheaper and easier to arrange than staging live wargames, the Xinhua news agency said on Saturday.
"The navy has entered the comprehensive computer era, with crews using...hi-tech machines to create realistic images of fighting," Xinhua said.
The navy now had about 200 virtual reality machines capable of simulating anti-aircraft strikes, helicopter-submarine battles and surface-to-surface missile launches, the agency said.
"The navy holds few combat exercises that use live ammunition each year, as they require extensive cooperation among related departments and large amounts of material resources," it said.
"The...training machines allow the navy to carry out high-quality exercises at any time," it said.
